name: Banded Waveguide
author: Lyle Mills, after Perry R. Cook and Gary P. Scavone
description: A bowed bar, bowl or glass. Each mode gets its own waveguide loop, so a bow has a travelling wave to grip -- which a bank of resonators does not.

controls.label: Material
controls.description: Selects the material: uniform bar, tuned bar, glass harmonica or Tibetan prayer bowl.

controls.label: Bow force
controls.description: Bow force, from a light steep grip to a broad heavy one that loosens the tone.

controls.label: Bow speed
controls.description: Bow speed. There is a best speed in the middle, as there is on a real instrument.

controls.label: Ring
controls.description: How long the bank rings once the bow lifts, from a dead bar to an almost endless bowl.

outputs.aux: The fundamental band alone, as a pitch reference.

upstream: STK BandedWG (Essl and Cook banded waveguides), thestk/stk
